name: Proton Intelligence Core
shortDescription: A unified AI orchestration and model-routing architecture designed to connect reasoning models, enterprise data, and governance controls.
overview: Currently under active engineering, Proton Intelligence Core is being architected as a modular foundation for deploying domain-specific AI assistants, retrieval pipelines, and observability controls with strict data privacy.

name: Proton Flow Engine
shortDescription: An adaptive workflow automation toolkit combining deterministic business rules with agentic AI decision steps.
overview: In prototyping, Proton Flow Engine focuses on eliminating repetitive operational bottlenecks by pairing structured task pipelines with human-in-the-loop verification checkpoints.

name: Proton Enterprise Workspace
shortDescription: Scalable cloud-native enterprise software modules built for secure collaboration, operational visibility, and long-term maintainability.
overview: Designed for organizations modernizing legacy workflows, Proton Enterprise Workspace provides clean modular interfaces, granular access control, and extensible APIs.

name: Proton Research LabBench
shortDescription: An experimental R&D environment exploring autonomous multi-agent literature synthesis, hypothesis structuring, and technical verification.
overview: Emerging directly from Proton Solutions' internal research initiatives, LabBench investigates how specialized AI agents can accelerate technical discovery while preserving source traceability.
